notes: All 12 views inspected. The glass roof and windows are translucent rather than physically refractive.. Panel gaps, glazing, lamp lenses, wheel arches and the underside floorpan are all modelled, and the top and bottom views confirm a closed body with no missing faces. No brand badge, wordmark or number plate appears anywhere.
limitations: Stylized, not photoreal: this is a Cozy-kit vehicle with a simplified pastel palette.
Wheels are separate objects pivoted on their hubs, so they can be rolled; the body itself is not rigged.
Interior is simplified; not suitable for a close-up cabin shot.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
